Examines how new regulatory instruments, including the EU AI Act, create binding obligations for AI providers to mark and detect AI-generated content, and what these obligations mean for media and technology companies in the emerging information ecosystem.

Research area: [Agentic AI Safety & Governance](/research/agentic-ai-safety/).
